name: Global Technology
description: For engineers, product people and tech investors who want the day's industry news plus what practitioners are actually discussing. Mixes mainstream tech newsrooms with Hacker News and Reddit signal.

themes.label: Products & Launches
themes.hint: Something shipped or was announced with a date: hardware, an app or OS release, a model or API, a pricing change or a deprecation. The story is the artifact and what it does, not the company's finances.

themes.label: Platforms & Business
themes.hint: Company as business: earnings, layoffs and reorganisations, executive changes, acquisitions and funding rounds, market share, advertising and subscription economics, and platform rule changes affecting developers or creators.

themes.label: AI & Compute
themes.hint: Machine learning systems and the infrastructure under them: model capability claims and benchmarks, training and inference cost, GPUs and accelerators, data centres and energy draw, agents and tooling. Excludes AI regulation, which is Policy & Regulation.

themes.label: Security & Privacy
themes.hint: Breaches and disclosed vulnerabilities, ransomware and state linked intrusions, patches and CVEs, surveillance and tracking, encryption, and data handling failures. A named victim, exploit or exposed dataset is the giveaway.

themes.label: Policy & Regulation
themes.hint: Governments acting on technology: antitrust suits and remedies, EU, US, UK, India and China rules, export controls and tariffs on chips, content moderation and age verification law, copyright and patent rulings.

themes.label: Engineering & Open Source
themes.hint: Work practitioners do: language and framework releases, notable open source projects and licence changes, architecture and performance write ups, developer tooling, standards, and postmortems of real incidents.

themes.label: Science & Frontier Tech
themes.hint: Technology not yet an industry: space launches and missions, quantum computing, biotech and neurotech, robotics, fusion and novel materials, and the research results behind them.
